scientific_integrity: The integer signed-cube rank and discriminant certificate is exact and exhausts 256 patterns; seven small-field complete-cube numerical checks are auxiliary. General validity additionally uses the standard finite-field quadratic Gauss-sum formula. No independent audit or novelty certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the equal-weight opposite diagonal quadratic chirps on prime-field vector spaces are evaluated. General mixtures, arbitrary quadratic forms, and other uniformity orders are not covered. Previously published equivalent evaluations may exist under Gaussian cube-correlation terminology.
title: Arithmetic interference in the cubic uniformity norm of a quadratic cosine chirp
